The prompt is oriented toward detecting conflicts, validating alignment, and identifying policy drift, which inherently promotes information integrity. It requires structured, evidence-based outputs including conflict lists with severity ratings and precedence models, supporting truthful and verifiable analysis.

The prompt follows a safety-conscious approach by limiting tools to read-only operations (Read, Glob, Grep) and setting a bounded execution limit (maxTurns: 10). The permission mode is set to 'default' rather than elevated. The agent's tasks are purely analytical—validation and detection—rather than executing or modifying anything.
